ANOV • DIG • REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE Legal Opinion No. 54 s. 2011 SEP MLGOO IMELDA P. CANEJA Municipal Local Government Operations Office Alangalang, Leyte Dear MLGOO Caneja: This has reference to your earlier letter requesting for enlightenment on the following iSSUes, which we quoted in toto: "1. 2. Can the subject Sangguniang Kabataan transact official business such as the formulation of the SK budget considering their current composition? What is the stand of the Department with regards to quorum?" In your letter, represented that there only five (5) registered members in the AugUSt 6-15, 2010 SK Special Registration in Barangay Bato, Alangalang, Leyte. Of the 5 members of the Katipunan ng Kabataan (KK), only three members ran for office and won during the October 2010 Synchronized Barangay and SK Elections so that at present, the SK of Barangay Bato is composed of an SK Chairman and two (2) SK Members. Hence your aforequoted queries. Since your queries are related, we deemed it proper to answer the same in one (1) discussion. In the Department Advisory dated 09 November 2010, in a case where there is an incomplete set SK officials elected in the 25 October 2010 Synchronized Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (SBSKE), the possible remedy available is to invoke Section 435 (c) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 71 60), which states that: "SECTION 435. Succession and Filling of Vacancies.--- xxx xxx xxx (c) After the vacancy shaZZ have been fitted, the sangguniang kabataan chairman shaZZ cau a special election to complete the membership of said sanggunian. Such sangguniang kabataan member shall hold office for the unexpired portion of the term of the vacant seat. " Accordingly, a special election shall be called upon by the SK Chairman at the barangay level at anytime. The concerned Punong Barangay and DILG Local Government Operations Officer (LGOO) shall provide assistance and

supervision of the special election. The officers to be elected in the said special elections shall only be such number of vacant seats to complete the seven-man membership of the Sangguniang Kabataan who shall serve the unexpired portion of the term. If despite the conduct of the aforesaid special elections, nobody filed a certificate of candidacy, the vacancy shall be remedied by appointment of SK officials by the President of the Philippines in the exercise of the latter's residual powers under Section 16, Article VII of the 1987 Constitution, subject to formulated guidelines on the matter. Pending appointment of the other SK officials, the remaining set of SK officials may already transact official business, including the formulation and enactment of the SK budget. In this regard, the definition of quorum under Section 53 (a) of the Local Government Code of 1991 is instructive, thus: "SECTION 53. A majority of the members qf the sanggunian who have been elected and qualified xxx." (Emphasis Supplied) Since there only three SK officials elected and namely, an SK Chairman and 2 SK members, applying the aforequoted definition of quorum, we are of the view that these SK officials may already validly transact official business. Hope we have addressed your concern accordingly. Very y OurS, A Ls/17 Copy furnished: ATTY. DARWIN N. BIBAR Chief, Finance and Administrative Division Officer-in-Charge DILG-Region VIII Kanhuraw Hill, Tacloban City . JESUS .D Dire tor Ill
